run_install_cuda_toolkit: run the script to download and install CUDA 12.3.2 components for the current platform
run_detect_platform: run detect_platform to auto-detect the CUDA platform identifier for the current system
run_fetch_redistrib_metadata: run fetch_redistrib_metadata to download the redistrib JSON metadata for a given CUDA version
run_download_and_extract: run the script to download cuda_cudart and cuda_nvcc archives and extract them to a directory
run_get_component_path: run get_component_path to look up the relative download path for a CUDA component and platform
